confidence_rationale: Canonical, heavily-cited theoretical/computational formalization of exactly the mechanism ARC-005 imports: neuromodulatory precision-weighting of top-down expectation vs bottom-up evidence (ACh = expected uncertainty, NE = unexpected uncertainty). High mapping fidelity to the ARC-005 premise that a control plane can route precision. But it is a MODEL paper, not an effect-size measurement, so it establishes that the routing mechanism is real and functionally consequential without itself bounding the magnitude an intervention should produce -- hence 0.72, not higher.
failure_signatures: The model predicts precision-weighting is FUNCTIONALLY LOAD-BEARING -- it changes how much sensory evidence updates belief -- not a negligible perturbation. A precision channel whose downstream effect is ~180x below cross-seed noise is not routing in the sense this model requires; it is decorative at the readout.

The model treats NE/ACh gain as multiplicative on the inference, so a channel that is architecturally invariant under normal committed operation (REE channel 2, ~97% committed) or reads a collapsed/degenerate upstream signal (REE channel 1's dACC adapter, response 4-7 orders of magnitude off scale) fails to implement the mechanism this paper describes.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Acetylcholine and norepinephrine report expected and unexpected uncertainty respectively, and these signals set the relative weighting (precision) of top-down predictions against bottom-up sensory input during inference and learning in noisy, changeable environments.
mapping.ree_translation: This is the formal import underlying ARC-005's control plane: a neuromodulatory channel (REE's 5-HT rigidity / phasic-burst gain / dACC precision readout) that routes precision -- i.e. exerts causal authority over how strongly evidence is weighted -- dissociable from the content being processed. The paper is the biological warrant that such routing exists and is causal, which is precisely the existence claim ARC-005 makes.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is a normative model, not a measured intervention. It says the mechanism is real and functionally consequential but does not by itself quantify how large a downstream readout shift a within-range channel manipulation should produce -- that number has to come from the empirical pharmacology entries in this review. The model also assumes the precision signal is actually wired into the inference update; REE's channel 1 finding (dACC adapter untrained on non-degenerate goal_proximity) is exactly a case where the wiring is present but the transmitted signal is off-scale.
mapping.source_context: Theoretical/computational neuroscience; approximate-Bayesian inference model of attentional cueing (Posner-style) with ACh/NE as uncertainty signals; no species/task-specific effect size.

confidence_components.notes: Venue and citation weight are very high; mapping fidelity to the ARC-005 premise is strong. Transfer risk is non-trivial because a formal model of biological neuromodulation does not automatically license quantitative predictions for REE's engineered channel implementation -- it grounds the mechanism, not the magnitude.
